description: A Flutter widget named FilterPills that displays a horizontally scrollable row of ChoiceChips, allowing users to select one filter option among multiple labels. The widget manages visual state for active selection and calls a callback when a pill is selected.

classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a scrollable list of choice chips for filtering options.
